release_notes: Tachyon AIO v0.45.44 fixes Generator navigation at the canonical Core v2 router layer. Generator is now a native generator -> generatorPane route in TachyonCore instead of depending on a feature-owned window.tab wrapper, so restoring or re-exporting the Core router can no longer leave the previously selected pane visible when Generator is clicked. Real-Chromium regression coverage now deliberately replaces window.tab with TachyonCore.navigate and verifies Generator opens as the sole active pane from every primary destination.
